source.name: EFFIS annual report, Forest Fires in Europe, Middle East and North Africa 2024, Publications Office of the European Union, annex Tables 101 to 104 with Table 1 for 2024, source JRC's elaboration of the country reports, and Table 2 for Bulgaria
source.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as stated on the report's own copyright page. Copyright European Union, 2025.
source.note: What the Executive Forest Agency reported, from its own database of forest fires, as the EFFIS annual report prints it in its annex and in Table 2 of its Bulgaria chapter. Forest fires only, so fires on other land are missing. The agency's own 2025 report later gives 2024 as 565 fires on the same area, 171 164 decares, which is 17 116.4 hectares (https://www.iag.bg/data/docs/Doklad25_01str_final_08.05.2026.pdf); the figure here is the 595 the 2024 report printed.

source.name: EFFIS (European Forest Fire Information System), estimates of burned areas and number of fires
source.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as stated on the EFFIS and GWIS Data License pages. Copyright European Union, 1995-2025.
source.note: Not a report. EFFIS, the European Forest Fire Information System, makes this estimate by mapping the burned area it can see in satellite images, and it maps mainly fires of about 30 hectares or more, so smaller fires are missing.
